name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom luxury homes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom luxury home construction?
mainEntity.text: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom luxury home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The difference between custom and semi-custom luxury homes comes down to design freedom and project control. A fully custom home is created from the ground up for a specific lot, lifestyle, and aesthetic, which allows the owner to shape the layout, structure, and finishes in detail. A semi-custom home uses an existing plan as the starting point, which can reduce design time and sometimes lower costs, but it also limits how much the home can be tailored. For luxury buyers, the right choice depends on whether the priority is uniqueness, speed, budget control, or a balance of all three. Custom construction is often the better fit for irregular lots, hillside sites, or highly specific architectural visions. Semi-custom can work well when the goal is a refined home with fewer design variables. Homeowners should ask how much of the design, structure, and finish package is actually flexible before deciding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom luxury homes are designed specifically for one owner and site, while semi-custom homes start from a predesigned plan with limited modifications. Custom homes offer more flexibility in layout, finishes, and site adaptation, but they usually take longer and cost more.
